column1: # CHM documentation sets to extract into the corpus
# name <TAB> output directory <TAB> chm glob(s), comma separated
# The CHMs live in sources/ (the untouched official media); the pages inside
# them are the documentation.  tools/extract-chm.py unpacks them with 7z,
# because the sandbox has no 7z but a GitHub runner does; the workflow
# .github/workflows/extract-chm.yml runs it and commits the result.
# Windows CE 5.0: the 98 component CHMs of the CE 5.0 CD1 (the platform
# builder documentation: component guides plus the API reference of each
# component).  Extracted per component, so the inventory prefix P302_ etc.
# does not become part of the page names.
